lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Gull Harbor, Washington. Population: twenty-one hundred and forty.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It rains here two hundred days a year.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And Drizzle is ready for every single one of them.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Drizzle... you're wearing your raincoat. Indoors.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Hey, you never know when it'll rain in here.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Uh-huh. I came for sugar. And to check your go-bag.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: My snack bag? It's right by the door.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Water, flashlight, meds, radio... then snacks.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Snacks are a food group, Mags.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Uh, Mags? Why is my mug... dancing?

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: That's an earthquake. Drop!

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: The doorway! We go to the doorway, right?

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: No, no — under the table. Cover!

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Grab a leg and hold on. Don't let go.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: It's still going...

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Big ones can last minutes. Stay put.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A magnitude nine can shake for three to five minutes.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Is the house supposed to make that noise?

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Hold on, kid. I've got you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then the lights went out.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then... nothing.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Is it over? Can I let go now?

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: You can let go. But we're not staying.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Oh... my kitchen.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: We're right on the coast. Shaking that long means one thing.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Okay, okay. Laptop... photo album... plant—

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Put it down. All of it.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Just the go-bag. Nothing else.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Can the plant at least come?

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: The plant can swim.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Outside, Gull Harbor looked... wrong.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Mags... where's all the water going?

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Out. And it's coming back. Bigger.

lines.speaker: NEIGHBOR
lines.text: Huh. No alert on my phone yet...

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: The shaking WAS the alert.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Why isn't the siren going off?

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Power's out. No siren's coming.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Don't wait for a warning. We walk uphill. Now.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Everybody! Uphill! Come on!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Out past the harbor mouth, the horizon began to rise.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Should we take your truck?

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Roads crack. Cars jam. Feet don't get stuck in traffic.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Hey! Leave the car! Walk with us!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The hill was twenty minutes away. On foot.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The evacuation trail. Steep. Muddy. Perfect.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Well... at least I'm getting my steps in.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Down! Cover your head and neck!

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Okay. I officially hate the ground.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Up. Keep moving.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Give me a second. These knees are old.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Lean on me. I'm very sturdy.

lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: ...tsunami warning for the Washington coast... move to high ground immediately...

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: See? It's official.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: And twenty minutes late. Climb.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Mags... you need to see this.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Don't stop. Don't watch. Keep going.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: A gray line stretched across the whole horizon.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: That's... that's not a cloud.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And it was moving fast.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Move! Go, go!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The first wave hit twenty-two minutes after the shaking.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: The dock... the ferry...

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Boats can be replaced. Keep climbing.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Climbing! I'm climbing!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The second wave was bigger.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Mags... Main Street. It's — it's all going.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: We're high enough here. Catch your breath.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Your house is down there...

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Houses get rebuilt. People don't.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: By the time the water pulled back, the lower town was gone.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The hilltop assembly area. Higher than any wave.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: We made it. We actually made it.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Because we didn't wait. Remember that.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The school got every kid up the hill. They'd practiced.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: ...Maybe I should practice.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Everyone should.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: Okay. So... three things.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One. Drop, cover, and hold on.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two. On the coast, if it shakes... walk uphill. Now.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Three. Grab the go-bag. Not your stuff.

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: And four: snacks.

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: ...Fine. Snacks.

lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: ...the Highway one-oh-one bridge at Gull Creek has collapsed...

lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: ...no road access to Gull Harbor at this time...

lines.speaker: DRIZZLE
lines.text: So... nobody's coming?

lines.speaker: MAGS
lines.text: Not today. Not by road.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then... a light on the water.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Next... Day one.
